notes.title: Update V0.78
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40113558/330b20a3c18e1a1f8dce898a634ff4b362782511.jpg


 Tutorial overhaul.
 Added private rooms to the multiplayer.
 Text assistance in FPS / TPS strategy, by Pressing[T].
 Corrected some typos.

notes.title: Hotfix V0.77.34
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented projectiles from being correctly registered.
 Added "Effective Fire" chart to the UI for every unit.
 Added more resolutions for "Fullscreen" mode.
 Tweaked AI performance for more engaging games.

notes.title: Hotfix V0.77.33
notes.content:
Tutorial level redesigned.
 Added more randomization to levels, so the same level won't be played as much as before.
 Updated commander ship devices' icons.

notes.title: Hotfix V0.77.3
notes.content:
Added Inverse Mouse Y-Axis option for First-Person and Air units.
 Rebalanced unit HP and income rates.
 Commander ship turrets now spawn at the beginning of the match.
